description: This file sets up a chatbot pipeline that integrates Gemini Live LLM with grounding metadata processing, using various transports and tools, and includes a custom processor to log grounding metadata from Google Search responses.

classes.name: GroundingMetadataProcessor
classes.description: A processor that logs grounding metadata from Gemini Live API responses, specifically handling LLMSearchResponseFrame instances.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Asynchronously processes a frame, logging grounding metadata details if the frame is an LLMSearchResponseFrame.

methods.name: run_bot
methods.description: Sets up and runs the pipeline with Gemini LLM, grounding metadata processor, and transport event handlers.

methods.name: bot
methods.description: Main entry point that creates the transport and starts the bot pipeline.
